## Problem

`skills/2-daily/merge-cleanup/SKILL.md:494-495` (batch issue protocol) says the script "does not run any test suite (GH-831): the caller still runs the sweep and writes the verdict." Since GH-1383, the script runs the post-merge QA sweep automatically at the end of a batch, unless the caller passes `--no-auto-sweep` (see the flag's help in `merge_cleanup.py`, and the GH-1383 automated-sweep bullet in the same SKILL.md). The two statements contradict each other, so a reader following the protocol section may run the sweep by hand a second time, or skip it expecting the script to.

## Source

Final QA nit in `relay-system/2026-11-17/gh1493-final-qa.md` (PR #1516), parked in `PARKED/2026-11-17-gh1493-closeout.md`.

## Fix

Confirm the auto-sweep path in `merge_cleanup.py`, then reword the sentence. For example: "It runs no new suite; the batch QA sweep runs automatically at batch end (GH-1383) unless `--no-auto-sweep` is passed, in which case the caller runs it and records the verdict with `--record-sweep`."

## Acceptance

- [ ] The batch protocol sentence and the GH-1383 bullet agree.
- [ ] Docs-only change; no new tests (AGENTS.md *No new tests*). Note: this SKILL.md is a full-gate route surface.

**Preparation research (GH-1476 trial, read-only, unpublished)**

The stale sentence is still at `skills/2-daily/merge-cleanup/SKILL.md:494-495`, at both branch `2e22cce0` and live `development` `6000f3de`. It contradicts the GH-1383 bullet at line 529.

The script lives at `skills/2-daily/merge-cleanup/scripts/merge_cleanup.py`. It has two relevant flags: `--record-sweep` (line 2470) and `--no-auto-sweep` (line 2471). It runs the sweep itself only in `--execute` mode, and only when the declared sweep command is set, not deferred, and not a `gh workflow run` dispatch (lines 2975-2985). In every other case it exits 4 with "landed, QA pending — record a verdict with --record-sweep" (lines 2986-2988).

The example rewording in the issue leaves out those other cases, so the fix should name them.

Overlap: open PR #1516 edits this file only around line 653, so there is no textual conflict.

Gate: `utils/ci-route.sh` routes this file to `docs_only=true full_required=true route=full` (kernel/gate surface). It needs the full gate, not the docs lane.

Proposed probe: `grep_present` on `any test suite \(GH-831\): the caller still runs the sweep`. It matches once now and does not match after a rewording.
